rating.label: Team strength
rating.test: the whole engine replayed cold on 2022-2025, seasons no layer was tuned on
rating.result: spread MAE 12.769 on 3127 games against the closing line’s 12.015; rating and home field alone: 12.989; left out on 2022-2025: weight k 0.91 (95% CI +0.86 to +0.96): real but over-weighted: the best-fit multiplier is 0.91
rating.status_text: The model’s base, tested as a whole

home_field.label: Home field
home_field.points_text: 2.8 pts for every home team, the same at every stadium (0 at a neutral site)
home_field.test: walk-forward 2014-2025, 8724 games, against the previous 4.082-pt constant
home_field.result: spread MAE −0.052 (95% CI −0.08 to −0.02), better in 11/12 seasons; a per-stadium table was tested and rejected: it tracked the home team’s own rating (corr 0.77), not the stadium; left out on 2022-2025: weight k 1.00 (95% CI +0.80 to +1.21), a check only, because the value was chosen on that window

matchup.label: Stylistic matchup
matchup.points_text: 8 learned offence-vs-defence pairings netted into one term. 4 move it with this season’s data (ball control vs front disruption, early-down offence vs early-down defence carry most of it); 4 never do, because the season feed does not supply their inputs (explosive offence vs explosive prevention, field position, passing efficiency vs pass defence, run game vs run defence)
matchup.test: left out of the shipped engine game by game on 2022-2025 (3127 games, no refit); weights fitted on 2014-2019 residuals (4331 games, in-sample r² 0.023)
matchup.result: MAE +0.037 better with it (95% CI −0.02 to +0.09, p = 0.20; better in 4 of 4 seasons); weight k 0.84 (95% CI +0.48 to +1.20): the shipped weight is consistent with the data (multiplier 0.84). Live, 0.42 pts of the term on average come from last season’s values for the unfed inputs, which no test covers
matchup.status_text: In the number, held-out gain not significant
